recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅系前驅細胞明顯增多，許多細胞質深藍、核圓而染色質細顆粒狀的早期紅血球母細胞，部分核輪廓不規則或呈芽狀；另見偏左移的顆粒球系與顆粒稀少的細胞，兩系以上都有發育異常，符合多系發育異常的 MDS。
features: Hypercellular smear with markedly increased erythroid precursors, many at the proerythroblast and basophilic erythroblast stages with deep blue cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with finely granular chromatin, some showing irregular nuclear contours or lobulation
Left-shifted granulopoiesis with promyelocytes and myelocytes containing pink-purple granules
Occasional granulocytic cells with reduced granulation and a cell with a lobulated, clumped nucleus
Background red cells and smeared cells; blasts are not obviously increased in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows marked erythroid hyperplasia composed largely of proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with deep blue cytoplasm and finely granular chromatin, several of which have irregular or lobulated nuclear contours. Granulopoiesis is left shifted, with promyelocytes and myelocytes, and occasional granulocytic cells show reduced cytoplasmic granulation. Blasts do not appear increased in this field, although an accurate count requires a full differential. Findings show dyserythropoiesis with granulocytic dysplasia and are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, provided blast percentage, ring sideroblasts and cytogenetics are assessed and reactive causes such as B12 or folate deficiency are excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and it corrects with vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, typically with TP53 mutation, rather than maturing erythroid hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia (hemolysis or blood loss recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation to orthochromatic normoblasts without nuclear irregularity or granulocytic hypogranulation.
AML-MR requires blasts at or above 20% (or the defined threshold) on a 500-cell differential, which morphology in a single field cannot establish.
